title: Sindh Urban State Land Cancellation Of Allotments Conversions And Exchanges Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Urban State Land Cancellation Of Allotments Conversions And Exchanges Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH URBAN STATE LAND (CANCELLATION OF ALLOTMENTS, CONVERSIONS AND
EXCHANGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
SINDH URBAN STATE
LAND (CANCELLATION OF ALLOTMENTS, CONVERSIONS AND EXCHANGES) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Urban State Land (Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and
Exchanges) Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 20th October, 2001]
No.S.LEGIS:1/(33)2001, dated
25-10-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Urban State Land
(Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges) (Amendment) Ordinance,
2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall always be deemed to have taken effect on and from 3rd January,
2001.

Exchanges) Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 20th October, 2001]
No.S.LEGIS:1/(33)2001, dated
25-10-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of the Sindh
Ordinance No. III of 2001.--In the Sindh Urban State Land (Cancellation of
Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges) Ordinance, 2001, hereinafter referred to
as the said Ordinance, for the word "Urban State Land" wherever
occurring, the words "Government Land" shall be substituted.
